title: Friction Kite: Annotated Requests and Mini-Experiments
content:
TLDR:
- Quick synthesis of top ~10 customer friction points collected from Dec 2029 outreach, in-app tickets, and SRE alerts.
- Each item includes: customer impact, frequency signal, a 1-3 line root-cause hypothesis, and 1–2 low-effort experiments we can run in Q1 2030.
- Purpose: create an actionable mini-experiment backlog for CS + SRE + Product to clear high-noise friction before launch window.

Notes on method: (informal)
- Sources: in-app error reports (Dec 1–18), CS triage Slack snippets, SRE incident summaries, two enterprise customer interviews (Acme Corp, Solstice AI).
- Priority lens: customer pain that consistently increases support load or blocks production usage (not feature asks).
- Signals used: ticket count (>5 in a week), repeat-retry ratio from telemetry, and demo-breaker severity from interview notes.
- Confidence: low/med/high tag per item (how sure we are of cause + fix).

Top friction items (annotated)
1) Tokenization mismatch causing hallucinated truncated outputs
- Signal: 7 enterprise tickets, 3 internal demos where result looked truncated mid-sentence.
- Impact: medium-high (users think model lost context; some retries costing tokens).
- Hypothesis: mismatches between client-side tokenizer and model runtime token boundaries when special tool-calling tokens present. Edge where function_call=true + streaming chunk boundary.
- Quick experiments: (a) instrument token boundary logging on a small % sample to confirm; (b) add a client-side guard that pads input with zero-width space before function call markers and measure error decline.
- Owner: Evan (SRE) + Product-hosted-api review.
- Confidence: medium.

2) Embedding drift after model swap (dedicated customers)
- Signal: 4 customers reported search quality drop after model pinned->upgrade; embedding similarity heat maps showed shift.
- Impact: high for customers relying on embeddings for retrieval.
- Hypothesis: new model variant has different embedding space; we lack an automated reindexing hint/warning.
- Quick experiments: (a) add a 'embedding-change-safeguard' flag that prevents auto-rollout for customers with >1M docs; (b) create a one-click reindex suggestion in Console with estimated time and cost.
- Linked ticket: JIRA:INF-997.
- Owner: Mateo + Product-optimize.
- Confidence: high.

3) Console route-level cost attribution mismatch
- Signal: multiple billing queries where token cost for a route did not match observed tokens in API logs (~15% variance).
- Impact: high for finance-concerned customers (billing disputes).
- Hypothesis: rounding/aggregation windows in the console UI differ from backend per-request aggregation; some streaming partials counted twice.
- Quick experiments: sync aggregation windows for a week in a shadow dashboard and compare; offer an interim explainer note in console.
- Owner: Lina (Product Console) + Billing infra.
- Confidence: medium.

4) Latency spikes when KV-cache invalidation collides with autoscale events
- Signal: SRE alerts + customer report during heavy batch runs.
- Impact: medium (sometimes breaches latency SLOs).
- Hypothesis: autoscaler termination during active KV cache flushes causes cold start with heavy recomputation.
- Quick experiments: (a) hold scale-down for 30s if active KV flush detected; (b) decouple cache eviction to background thread.
- Owner: Serving-runtime + SRE.
- Confidence: medium-low.

5) Function-calling noise: misleading error messages for schema mismatch
- Signal: Support threads where error "invalid input" lacked schema hint; customers re-open tickets.
- Impact: low-medium but high annoyance.
- Hypothesis: runtime translates schema mismatch to generic error; should echo expected schema and offending field.
- Quick experiments: modify error formatter to include the field path (safe to show) for 25% of requests in sandbox.
- Owner: DevX + Serving-runtime.
- Confidence: high.

6) Private deployment onboarding friction: VPN + KMS ordering complexity
- Signal: two P0 delays with new private customers; blocked for infra procurement steps.
- Impact: high for sales pipeline.
- Hypothesis: onboarding doc outdated w.r.t KMS key naming conventions and network CIDR examples.
- Quick experiments: (a) create a minimal "network checklist" template for customer infra teams; (b) run a 2-hour onboarding dry run with Solutions Eng.
- Owner: Solutions Engineering + Sales Ops.
- Confidence: high.

7) Reranking SDK: poor defaults causing long tail latency for small documents
- Signal: SDK telemetry shows default batch size too aggressive for short inputs -> time to first token delayed.
- Impact: medium (affects search/relevance use cases).
- Hypothesis: default batch/window config tuned for large seqs; small-doc patterns penalized.
- Quick experiments: adjust SDK default to smaller batch for inputs < 512 tokens and run A/B.
- Owner: Developer Experience.
- Confidence: medium.

8) Model selection routing confusion (console vs API policy mismatch)
- Signal: customers reported different model after canary rollout depending on Console routing config vs API request header.
- Impact: medium-high for deterministic results usage.
- Hypothesis: Console UI uses "user-tier" inference policy while API header uses route config; mismatch surfaced when users set both.
- Quick experiments: (a) add a warning in Console when conflicting route+user policies exist; (b) surface effective policy in API response headers for diagnostics.
- Owner: Product (routing) + Console.
- Confidence: medium.

9) Metrics retention vs compliance ask mismatch
- Signal: one enterprise asked for 1yr retention for cost/latency traces; platform currently 90 days.
- Impact: high for compliance customers.
- Hypothesis: retention tiering exists but not exposed in pricing/console.
- Quick experiments: prototype a retention toggle for logs with cost estimate in Console (beta).
- Owner: Security & Compliance + Observability.
- Confidence: medium-high.

10) Misleading default error retry behavior in SDKs
- Signal: some customers double-sent requests because SDK retried non-idempotent calls.
- Impact: high (duplicates, downstream cost).
- Hypothesis: SDK retry policy insufficiently conservative for non-idempotent endpoints; docs not explicit.
- Quick experiments: change default SDK to no-retry for text-generation non-idempotent methods, add clear doc block and migration note.
- Owner: Developer Experience + SDK owners.
- Confidence: high.

Open questions / unknowns (short list):
- Are embedding reindex costs acceptable to customers if recommended automatically? (ask Sales for thresholds)
- For tokenization bug: can we repro in-house with existing integration tests or do we need staged customer sample?
- How many customers would flip retention to 1yr vs paying extra? (finance model needed)

Proposed immediate next steps (owner + ETA):
- Dec 27–Jan 5: instrumentation spike (Evan) for token boundaries and streaming counts (2w).
- Jan 6–Jan 20: Console cost aggregation shadow run + billing explainer (Lina + Billing).
- Jan 6–Feb 15: Run embedding-change-safeguard pilot with 3 customers (Mateo + Product-optimize).
- Jan 8–Jan 22: SDK default retry policy PR and doc update (DevX).

Low-effort quick wins (<= 2 dev days):
- Add console explainer modal for cost variance (Lina).
- Error message tweak for function-calling schema (Serving-runtime).
- SDK default retry toggle to off for non-idempotent (DevX).

Decision log (running):
- 2029-12-24: agreed to prioritize tokenization logging and SDK retry change first (CS + DevX).
- 2029-12-26: decided to bundle embedding safeguard as a Q1 pilot for large customers.

Notes to self / friction-y snippets: 
- Customer phrasing often: "the model looks like it forgot the middle of the prompt" — likely either token boundary or trimming + re-tokenization.
- Sales feedback: "If reindex costs are shown we close more deals" — validate with 2 AE reps.
- Keep experiments scoped: one change + one metric to avoid confounding.

Attachments / pointers (internal):
- sample logs: slack thread -> #cs-ops (Dec 19) contains raw customer transcripts (link above).
- telemetry dashboard: /dashboards/streaming-token-boundary (internal id).

PRIORITY: tokenization logging + SDK retry policy (blockers to open deals & repeated support churn).

If you want a compact table view for handoff to PMs/Eng leads I can convert items 1–10 into a 1-slide decision grid (owner/effort/risk/ETA).

-- Asha
(Notes: we should rinse these priorities against product roadmap on Jan 3rd. This doc intentionally light on final designs — aim = fast experiments and clear ownership.)
